errorCodes.meaning: The caller administers no namespace — they hold neither the community-administrator capability nor a live, explicitly recorded `git.ns.admin` — or `namespace` names one they do not administer or one this VTC does not have. The three are answered alike, so the code cannot be used to learn which namespaces exist.

Did.description: A bare DID in the W3C DID Core syntax (§3.1): `did:`, a method name of lowercase letters and digits, `:`, and a method-specific id of colon-separated segments drawn from `A-Z a-z 0-9 . - _` and percent-encoded octets, the last segment non-empty. A DID URL is not a DID: no path, query or fragment (`/`, `?`, `#`), so a verification-method id such as `did:key:z6Mk…#z6Mk…` is refused. Compared by exact string equality — no case folding or percent-decoding. A consumer MUST still treat the value as data: the pattern keeps shell metacharacters, whitespace and quotes out of the wire form, but it does not make a DID safe to splice into a command or markup.
Did.title: Did

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

JobId.description: The VTC's identifier for the job, unique across the VTC's jobs. The same identifier git-ns/bridge/job (0.4 to 0.6) assigns and git-ns/bridge/result (0.1 and 0.2) reports against.
JobId.title: JobId

JobKind.description: What the job asks the bridge to do — the same eight kinds git-ns/bridge/job/0.6 defines. Kept as its own enum here, rather than a cross-file $ref, because job/0.6 declares its `kind` inline rather than as a named $def; the two lists change together.
JobKind.title: JobKind

JobRow.description: One bridge job as the administrator's console shows it.

acceptedAt.description: When a bridge last accepted it. Absent while `state` is `pending` or `cancelled`.

attempts.description: How many times the VTC has dispatched this job to a bridge.

bridgeDid.description: The bridge the job was dispatched to.

createdAt.description: When the VTC queued the job.

lastError.description: The bridge's last reported error, verbatim. Diagnostic prose for an administrator; a consumer MUST NOT parse it. Absent unless `state` is `partial` or `failed`.

number.description: The pull request a `closePullRequest` job closes, in `repo` — the job's own `number`. Present for a `closePullRequest` job and absent for every other kind.

repo.description: The repository the job acts on. Absent for a namespace-wide `inspect` sweep or a job with no repository (`beginBind`, `beginAccountLink`).

JobRow.title: JobRow

JobState.description: The VTC's own queue state for the job, driven by git-ns/bridge/result/0.2 reports. `pending` — queued, not yet accepted. `accepted` — the bridge has taken it and not yet reported an outcome. `succeeded` — every step completed. `partial` — some steps completed and at least one did not. `failed` — no step completed. `cancelled` — withdrawn before the bridge accepted it.
JobState.title: JobState

NamespaceId.description: The VTC's opaque identifier for a namespace, assigned when it is bound. Stable for the life of the binding; never reused for another binding.
NamespaceId.title: NamespaceId

RepoResource.description: A forge-qualified resource naming exactly one repository: `<forge-host>/<owner>/<repo-path>`, lowercase, where the repository path has 1 to 21 segments (see `Resource`).
RepoResource.title: RepoResource

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as the request's `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

schema.description: A namespace's administrators list the bridge jobs queued or run for it — every namespace, for a community administrator — with each job's kind, state and last error. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`. A consumer supplying a `cursor` MUST NOT also change `namespace` or `state` from the request that produced it — start a fresh query instead.

limit.description: Maximum jobs to return in this page. A VTC clamps to 1..=500 (default 100).

namespace.description: Only jobs in this namespace. Absent: every administered namespace.

schema.title: Git Namespaces — List Bridge Jobs — payload
